Plush answers.

The real questions. Without the divine mystery.

What is Musegod?+

Musegod is the mascot of swarm memes on Robinhood Chain. $MUSEGOD is its fixed-supply ERC-20 token. The plush lore is branding, not a promise of financial value.

Where can I buy MUSEGOD?+

On the SIMD Launchpad coin page, using IMD on Robinhood Chain. The Buy and Chart links on this site come from the launch’s live metadata. Before those links are available, the Buy button takes you to the guide.

Why does the contract say launching…?+

The token address does not exist until deployment. The site displays launching… until a valid token address arrives from /simd-coin.json. It never invents an address.

What are the token fees?+

Transfers from the Uniswap v4 PoolManager take a fixed 2% fee, sent directly to the treasury. Sells and user-to-user transfers have no token fee. Uniswap’s separate pool fee is 1.25%.

Where does the supply go?+

The constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens to the deployer. The launch factory sends 10% to its Merkle distributor for swarm builders and allocates 90% to pool seeding. Any rounding remainder goes to the fixed launch remainder address.

Can anyone mint more or change the rules?+

No. Supply, fee rate, PoolManager and treasury are fixed. There is no owner, administrator, upgrade mechanism, public mint or burn function.

Do liquidity withdrawals pay the buy fee?+

Yes. The rule checks whether the sender is the PoolManager. Every PoolManager outflow is subject to the same 2% token fee, including liquidity withdrawals. Fee amounts round down to the nearest minor unit. The token only sees ERC-20 transfers: a swap kept or paid as a Uniswap v4 ERC-6909 claim inside the PoolManager is not taxed until the claim is withdrawn as tokens.

Does this site connect to my wallet?+

No. This is an information and meme website. Wallet connection and swapping happen on the launchpad. The meme downloads and blessing counter stay in your browser; no personal information is collected.

Are the stats and social posts real?+

Market stats appear only when real numeric values arrive from /simd-coin.json and refresh every 30 seconds. Stale or unavailable values are hidden. No social feed is configured, so the site links to #MUSEGOD on X instead of inventing posts.

Can I share and download the memes?+

Yes. Each of the eight compositions has a PNG download. Share buttons open X with a prefilled message, and Copy site link copies the public Musegod URL. These actions do not post anything for you.

No questions match. Try “fees”, “supply” or “wallet”.
